titles: Flesh and Bone: The Resurrection You Inherit
Loved Exactly as Jesus Is Loved
The Renewed Mind and the Hidden Faculty

theme_succession.title: Unlearning What Was Handed Down
theme_succession.purpose: Open with the diagnosis: inherited custom and secondhand information replacing direct hearing from God.
theme_succession.summary: Direct hearing, bodily discipline, cultural food habits, tradition versus faith, ambition for long life.

theme_succession.title: Flesh and Bone: The Resurrection You Inherit
theme_succession.purpose: Lay the central doctrinal correction about physical resurrection and restored sonship.
theme_succession.summary: Flesh and bone inheritance, sons of men becoming sons of God, Adam's failure and Christ's intercession, life already possessed.

theme_succession.title: Hebrews 2: Death Already Destroyed
theme_succession.purpose: Work the group exposition of Hebrews 2 and its consequences for preaching and fear.
theme_succession.summary: Live reading of Hebrews 2, translation dispute, African demonic emphasis, power already indwelling, accountability for the gospel preached.

theme_succession.title: Priest, Prophet, King
theme_succession.purpose: Set out the sacred offices, the ordered priesthood, and the warnings attached to it.
theme_succession.summary: Shadow and fulfillment, three offices, universal versus ordered priesthood, Melchizedek, Malachi's warning, not despising the calling.

theme_succession.title: Access, Not Achievement
theme_succession.purpose: Dismantle condition-based access to God: anointing, offering, worship, fasting.
theme_succession.summary: Activating the anointing, heart behind sacrifice, worship as fellowship, simplicity of receiving power, purpose and limits of fasting.

theme_succession.title: That They May Be One
theme_succession.purpose: Make John 17 the structural spine: union, glory, preservation, and the critique of rapture-centered focus.
theme_succession.summary: Jesus' prayer, sanctification, unity and glory, honesty about one's stand, rapture critique, overflow of communion, the Holy Spirit as person, the promised dimension, sensitivity to spiritual levels.

theme_succession.title: Loved Exactly as Jesus Is Loved
theme_succession.purpose: Hold the unconditional love text against conditions preachers add, then show God's use of flawed people.
theme_succession.summary: John 17:23 on divine love, illegitimate conditions, goodness producing purity, imperfect biblical figures carrying great power.

theme_succession.title: Set Your Mind Above
theme_succession.purpose: Move from doctrine to the first practical discipline: fixing the mind on heavenly reality.
theme_succession.summary: Colossians 3 practice, Philippians 4:8 in ordinary life, mind as battlefield, completeness under the Head.

theme_succession.title: Laws You Gave Yourself
theme_succession.purpose: Expose self-imposed legalism from imitation and recover personal uniqueness before God.
theme_succession.summary: Imitation-born rules, individuality of spiritual experience, God's intimate knowledge, long process behind testimonies, historical cost of discipleship and coerced religion.

theme_succession.title: Spirit, Soul and Body
theme_succession.purpose: Give the anatomy that the practice chapters depend on.
theme_succession.summary: Tripartite man, conscience, soul as hub, the dying that began at the Fall, growth into sonship, the devil's nature and contested identifications.

theme_succession.title: Reasonings and Strongholds
theme_succession.purpose: Distinguish natural knowledge from revelation and define the believer's real combat.
theme_succession.summary: Simplicity in Christ, flesh-and-blood knowledge, relevance to one's society, pastoral discernment in miracle settings, weapons and captive thoughts.

theme_succession.title: Prayer Corrected
theme_succession.purpose: Reform prayer practice: tongues rightly used, correction received, hunger as the condition.
theme_succession.summary: Misused tongues, refreshment through tongues, the speaker's correction, sincerity without knowledge, hunger and thirst as anchor.

theme_succession.title: The Renewed Mind and the Hidden Faculty
theme_succession.purpose: Teach renewal of the mind and imagination as the method of lasting communion.
theme_succession.summary: Living sacrifice through renewal, the brain as instrument, imagination as God-given faculty, bringing Jesus into thought, trained meditation.

theme_succession.title: Operating What You Have
theme_succession.purpose: Move into the exercise of power: abnormal faith, short prayer, hands, holiness, effortless gifts.
theme_succession.summary: Abnormal acts and short prayers, humility about untested doctrine, hands as doorways, holiness and simple faith, gifts flowing without struggle.

theme_succession.title: Grace Barely Touched
theme_succession.purpose: Show how much is already given and how believers testify to discovering it.
theme_succession.summary: Grace exceeding imagination, Moses contrasted with indwelling, retreat testimonies, healing already accomplished, progressive understanding, the sower as stages of one life.

theme_succession.title: Death as Gain
theme_succession.purpose: Resolve the fear-of-death thread opened in the resurrection chapters.
theme_succession.summary: No fear of death, fear as the devil's old strategy, death as gain lived rather than recited, peaceful departures.

theme_succession.title: Nothing by Chance
theme_succession.purpose: Make intentionality the organizing practice: speech, protection, and the responsibility of choice.
theme_succession.summary: Deliberate daily practice, aura of protection, speech correction, poverty as choice not design, balancing warning and promise.

theme_succession.title: Testimonies of Resurrection
theme_succession.purpose: Demonstrate the doctrine through resurrection accounts and the humility that must accompany them.
theme_succession.summary: The buried girl raised, activation of what God ordained, the young man raised, a prayer that did not succeed, the vessel's role.

theme_succession.title: Out of the Eater
theme_succession.purpose: End with providence that reverses harm and the prophetic vision for the nation.
theme_succession.summary: Stolen Bible turned redemptive, loss treated as seed, declared exponential growth, vision of a transformed nation and a call to pray together.
